children: Over 70 companies, including major private sector banks such as HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and others, will be reporting their September quarter results during the course of the upcoming week. While Monday and Tuesday are relatively lighter days in terms of result reports, the action picks up from Wednesday onwards. Here is a day-wise breakdown of the companies coming out with numbers from Monday, October 12.
Adroit Industries, HCLTech, ICICI Prudential AMC, Plastiblends, RBL Bank, Swan Defence, and Swaraj Engines.
Den Networks, GTPL Hathway, Hero Motors, ICICI Prudential Life, PNB Gilts, SS Retail, Transformers & Rectifiers, and Tata Elxsi.

Bajaj Consumer Care, BHEL, Aditya Birla Money, Canara Bank, CEAT, Elecon Engineering, Emmvee Photovoltaic, Groww, Hathway Cables, HDB Financial Services, ICICI Lombard, MRPL, Reliance Industrial Infra, Tata Technologies, and The Leela Palace Hotels & Resorts.

360 ONE WAM, 5Paisa Capital, Angel One, Butterfly Gandhimathi, CCL Products, Cyient DLM, DB Corp, HDFC AMC, HDFC Life, Heritage Foods, IIFL Finance, IRFC, Jio Financial Services, L&T Finance, Metro Brands, Nestle India, Orient Electric, Persistent Systems, Polycab, South Indian Bank, Sterling & Wilson Renewables, Tata Communications, Tech Mahindra, Tips Music, and Wipro.
